name: Dendrorhynchoides
sum: One of the smallest known pterosaurs, an anurognathid probably from the Early Cretaceous Yixian Formation of Liaoning, China.
holotype: GMV2128 — probably Jianshangou Bed, Yixian Formation, Liaoning (bought from dealers; tail faked with dromaeosaur bones).
material: Near-complete, crushed skeleton of a subadult. A second species, D. mutoudengensis, is known from the Jurassic Tiaojishan Formation.
biology: Short, broad skull and recurved teeth; a nimble aerial insectivore.
author: Ji et al. 1999
